method: One local CEM population: 16 centered action-output bias parameters gated by raw newest-frame score; original native final success and game time
notes: Biases are candidate strategy parameters, not scripted action prefixes.
The source NN checkpoint is unchanged; JSON/replay are diagnostic artifacts, not a checkpoint with these added parameters.
Native physics, raw observations, clock, actions, course and termination remain unchanged.
Selection filters: native final success, no truncation, low posture <=0.1, backward fraction after 5 s <=0.2.
